in_marathi.name: Ujjvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Descendant of the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ujjvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ujj means sky and vansh means descendant, so the name Ujjvansh means 'descendant of the sky'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is commonly used in Hindu culture.
